entry_points.summary: Conversational bounded idea-sharpener; $ARGUMENTS=empty opens with 'What are you thinking about?'; runtime=c1, no subagent for the interview itself.
Restates the idea back in 2-3 concrete sentences (actors, pain, scope); invites correction before probing.
Per-turn: (A) codebase self-serve via Haiku Explore, (B) conversational probe/reframe, (C) bounded escalation to pin a single fuzzy dimension with recommended answer. Not a structured checklist.
Terminates when concrete problem + minimal scope + key open forks are clear. User must confirm; or user's own signal accepted. Stage 4 only on confirmation.
Derives slug; collision-checks via plan-path.sh all_plan_slugs (precontext-only=continuation/no-prompt; finished-plan=AskUserQuestion); writes GRILL.md; advisory handoff only — never auto-dispatches.

Frontmatter: generated_at, status:complete, slug. Sections: Sharpened problem, Pain evidence, Who else has this, Dumbest version that solves 80%, Killed scope, Open branches, Recommended next command.

invariants: User always owns convergence — AI never writes GRILL.md before user signals convergence
Bounded adaptive escalation: start conversational; escalate to pin a fuzzy dimension only as needed; stop once the idea is buildable
Never exhaustively interrogate every dimension — that is /z-grill's job; if systematic probing tempts, recommend /z-grill instead
Abandonment is clean — no GRILL.md written; only sharpen_run_end with status:abandoned emitted
No subagents for the interview — Haiku Explore is the only allowed subagent, used to self-serve codebase-answerable questions only
Writes GRILL.md (NOT BRAINSTORM.md) — schema identical to /z-grill output; /z-brainstorm owns BRAINSTORM.md
Three logging events: sharpen_run_start (setup), sharpen_convergence (Stage 4 pre-write), sharpen_run_end (terminal — complete or abandoned)
Slug collision: precontext-only dir (no PLAN.md/SPEC.md/TASKS.md) = continuation/overwrite no prompt; finished-plan dir = AskUserQuestion
Empty $ARGUMENTS opens with 'What are you thinking about?' — entire conversation discovers the topic
Advisory handoff only — never auto-dispatches to /z-plan or /z-brainstorm; user runs the next command themselves
No active-plan registration — /z-sharpen is not a plan-family command
gotchas: z-sharpen = adaptive + bounded; /z-grill = exhaustive + deliberate — must remain distinguishable so /z-grill is not vestigial
Writes GRILL.md not BRAINSTORM.md — downstream commands expecting BRAINSTORM.md will not find z-sharpen output
planning-router rule 5: premise_underspecified routes to /z-sharpen only if current_command is NOT /z-sharpen (loop prevention guard at agents/planning-router.md:146)
GRILL.md schema is shared with /z-grill — last-writer-wins if both run on the same slug
No active-plan registration — /z-sharpen is not a plan-family command
Precontext-only collision is silent overwrite (no prompt); finished-plan collision requires AskUserQuestion — distinguish the two cases carefully
When auto-invoked inline by /z-brainstorm Phase 0, z-sharpen runs in the same conversation turn (no sub-agent dispatch); SHARPEN_ABANDONED=1 on abandon lets z-brainstorm continue
